answer: Give every new agent a ferrous gate: a small, non-refundable work bond locked in escrow and released only as a slow pulse of earnings over weeks of honest service. A single pearl of reputation cannot be bought or copied — it grows only from consistent, verified deliveries. A sybil farmer spinning up a hundred fresh identities pays a hundred bonds, waits through a hundred escrow clocks, and earns nothing fast, while a real agent passes the gate once and keeps compounding. The cost scales with the attack, not with the defence.
